cases.title: CDTWL says the water must stay 150 mm below the pit lid, and names the pits that fail
cases.plan_item: CDTWL freeboard (gap plan section 3 item 7; regression C39; run 47 B.4.4)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with card C39 (TEST_CASES_DRAFT_22OCT.md) and robot run 47 B.4.4: the 40 mm line for pit C1, two 110 mm lines, That is enough, one completed outcome line. The 150 mm figure is a regression baseline, not an engineering approval.
cases.expected: After typing CDTWL with the two answers 10 (the detention volume in cubic metres) and 18.70 (a top water level in metres), the command line says 'Only 40 mm between the water and the lid of pit C1 (150 mm is wanted).', says 'Only 110 mm' for two more pits (P1 and P7), says 'That is enough.', asks nothing more, and the Civil log holds one 'Command outcome: CDTWL completed' line.
cases.why_not_unit: The result depends on the real pit cover levels and the installed freeboard setting read inside the drawing; the words only exist on the live command line.
not_automated: The 150 mm freeboard is a regression baseline recorded on 22 Oct, not an engineering approval of that figure (engineering judgement stays with Tim).
The two answers are those of run 47; the first prompt reads "Detention volume required, in cubic metres (from the STORM report)". The 18.70 level prompt was not read here.

cases.title: Edit Pipe on P3 with new levels updates 4 pipes and 3 pits downstream, one U takes it all back, REDO puts it back
cases.plan_item: Edit Pipe cascade with U and REDO (gap plan section 3 item 7; regression C40; UX-LBL-02)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with card C40 (TEST_CASES_DRAFT_22OCT.md, spec 5.10 C40) and robot run 47 B.4.5: same route and the same expected lines. Differences: Save is pressed as the button named Edit pipe, Save (renamed on 3.0.72); the new pit P8 is not added; the invert texts are compared as one whole set (before, after the cascade, after U, after REDO), not per pipe, which closes the card's open point that U must restore the old levels.
cases.expected: Select pipe P3 (10A98D), CDEDIT, answer Y to the older-version question, set the first invert 17.60 and the second 17.50, press Edit pipe, Save (id C2.OkCommand); the box 'Recalculate downstream inverts' answered Yes opens the Cascade Preview; Apply says '[CDEDIT-CASCADE] Updated 4 pipes and 3 pits from P3 (IL 17.50). Min grade: 1:16.'; the invert texts in the drawing change; one U echoes CDEDIT and every invert text reads as before the edit; after a 12 second wait REDO says 'Everything has been redone' and the invert texts read as after the cascade.
cases.why_not_unit: The real Edit Pipe window, the downstream recalculation, the invert texts, the project data and AutoCAD's undo stack all take part; only a live drawing shows that one U undoes the whole cascade and that REDO is still available.
not_automated: Which text belongs to which pipe is not mapped: the case compares the whole set of 'IL ' texts (handle and wording, in drawing order) as one string, not one pipe's text. Project data (the stored invert values) is not read.

C40 stored pipe levels, linked-text ownership, the Recalculate box body (17.30 to 17.50 wording) and the STUB to X1 missing-level warning are NOT proved: this case guards the invert-text sequence and the command echoes only. The STUB to X1 warning did not appear on the command line or in the CE log of probe b5p1 (Civil 3.0.78), so no assertion for it could be written (cx_cr03 asked for the recorded text, not a guess).

cases.title: CDSYNC warns first, relinks 12 pits and 50 pipes, leaves every Pit Schedule row exactly as it was, and U echoes CDSYNC
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 26 Oct 2026 with the independent review cx_cr03 (R13 section) and daily card D27 (CDSYNC half) and card C42: warning sentence, counts, object count, and now the schedule rows before and after CDSYNC. D27 CDREBUILD and the schedule header counts are NOT covered.
cases.expected: (U note: the first U after the schedule echoes PITSCHEDULE, the second echoes CDSYNC.) Typing PITSCHEDULE shows the schedule; Close closes it. Typing CDSYNC prints '[CE] CDSYNC will re-link every pit and pipe in this drawing' and later 'CDSYNC complete. Pits relinked: 12, Pipes relinked: 50' (in that order); the number of objects in the drawing does not change; the Civil log holds one 'Command outcome: CDSYNC completed'; opening the Pit Schedule again shows exactly the same rows and cells as before; one U echoes CDSYNC and the object count is as before.
cases.why_not_unit: The order of the warning against the real write is only visible on the live command line, the relink counts and the schedule rows come from the real drawing.
not_automated: D27 CDREBUILD is not driven (its prompts are unknown). The U echo and the equal object count do not prove that the relinked records were restored.
The schedule HEADER (issue header, counters) is not compared: only the grid rows and cells. A look at the schedule layout is a separate Codex look (R25).
